text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Summer Training Camp" starts today! 
The Umamusume will begin their intensive 
training at the academy's special 
facility!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Would you like some water too, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"The staff were handing them out. 
Apparently, it's one of the local 
specialties here."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"When in Rome, do as the Romans do. To get 
used to an environment, it's important to 
proactively engage with it yourself♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After draining the water offered by Sakura 
Laurel, we begin our training camp 
routine.
